categories.name: Geography Trait
categories.description: Geography traits determine the general layout of landmasses of the realm.

categories.name: Clime Trait
categories.description: Clime traits modify the overlay and theme composition of the realm.

categories.name: Inhabitants Trait
categories.description: Inhabitants' traits modify the composition of independent armies on the realm.

categories.name: Presence Trait
categories.description: Presence traits add unique leaders and empires to the realm.

categories.name: Misc Trait
categories.description: Misc traits apply a variety of effects that adjust the game rules or otherwise provide twists to the realm.

traits.name: Barren Oceans
traits.description: Contested landmasses separated by uninhabitable deserts where sandstorms rage.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of several large landmasses separated by oceans of Uninhabitable Deserts.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a landmass with one or two other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Uninhabitable Desert [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by Sandstorms.</bullet><bullet>All surface combat in these [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_SANDSTORM]Blinding Sandstorm[/hyperlink] </bullet><bullet>Units in these [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SANDSTORMS_UNIT_PROPERTY]Blinding Sandstorm[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Barren Pangaea
traits.description: This realm is dominated by a single, enormous connected landmass surrounded by uninhabitable Deserts on all sides.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of a single massive landmass surrounded by uninhabitable Deserts.</bullet><bullet>Mountain/Stalagmites [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Coast
traits.description: This realm consists of a single connected landmass next to a small sea.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm features a single massive landmass.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Continents
traits.description: This realm is dominated by several large contested landmasses.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of several large landmasses separated by oceans.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a landmass with one or two other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Divide
traits.description: A land-dominated realm divided in two by an ocean.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of two massive landmasses separated by an ocean.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Islands
traits.description: This realm is dominated by oceans, but features many small islands.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of several small landmasses separated by oceans.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] has their own landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Land
traits.description: This realm consists of one large landmass without any large bodies of water.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm features a single massive landmass.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Lava Divide
traits.description: This realm features primarily land, divided in two by an ocean of lava.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of two massive landmasses separated by an impassable ocean of lava.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Lava Lakes
traits.description: This realm consists of one large landmass pocked with lakes of lava.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm features a single massive landmass.</bullet><bullet>This realm features lakes of lava.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Pangea
traits.description: This realm is dominated by a single, enormous connected landmass surrounded by ocean on all sides.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of a single massive landmass surrounded by oceans.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Scarred Divide
traits.description: This realm suffered a great scarring in the past, marking it with death and dividing the land.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of two massive landmasses separated by an uninhabitable, desolate ocean.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Void Divide
traits.description: A land-dominated realm divided in two by an impassible void.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of two massive landmasses separated by Astral Void.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Void Pangea
traits.description: This realm is dominated by a single, enormous connected landmass surrounded by Astral Void on all sides.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of a single massive landmass surrounded by impassable Astral Void.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Void Pockets
traits.description: This realm consists one large landmass pocked with impassible void.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm features a single massive landmass.</bullet><bullet>This realm features lakes of Astral Void.</bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Blessed Fields
traits.description: This realm features mostly rolling plains, some of which have been blessed by Celestial grace.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept]Blessed[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HandcraftedRegionConcept]Handcrafted Regions[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Desert Realm
traits.description: This World's climate is warm and dry, leaving little for flora to thrive on.<bulletlist><bullet>Desert [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Arctic, Highlands, Temperate and Desolate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Forest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Wetlands [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Endless Fields
traits.description: This realm features mostly rolling green plains, where food is abundant.<bulletlist><bullet>Temperate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Desolate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Grassland [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet><food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Forming Realm
traits.description: This realm is young and little of it has yet formed from its volcanic crucible. Over time it will become a new realm, chaotic as it may be.<bulletlist><bullet>The following [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink] is <abilityblue>common</abilityblue>: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The following Province Features are <abilityblue>absent</abilityblue>: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SunlessConcept]Sunless[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each Round, all unowned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] have a small chance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept]Terraforming[/hyperlink] into having different Province Features.</bullet><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>absent</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Frozen Realm
traits.description: This World's climate is harsh and cold. Frozen plains take the place of lush grasslands.<bulletlist><bullet>Arctic and Highlands [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Desert, Desolate, Temperate and Tropical [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Overgrown Realm
traits.description: A realm where plant life flourishes nearly everywhere.<bulletlist><bullet>Forest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Desert and Arctic [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Desolate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Scorched Climate
traits.description: This realm's climate is marked by scorching heat.<bulletlist><bullet>Desolate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Arctic, Temperate and Highlands [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Tropical Realm
traits.description: The realm is a tropical paradise, with golden sands, rolling jungles, and the occasional swamp.<bulletlist><bullet>Tropical, swamp, and forest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Arctic, desert, and desolate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Blossom Orchard [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] and Prestigious Statue [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Abundant.</abilityblue></bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Warped Seasons
traits.description: The seasons are unusually potent on this realm, causing constant change and turmoil.<bulletlist><bullet>Each season, a part of the land is [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept]terraformed[/hyperlink] into different climes and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each season, different weather effects are active.</bullet><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] become vulnerable to <damageBlight></damageBlight> Blight, <damageFire></damageFire> Fire, <damageLightning></damageLightning> Lightning, or <damageFrost></damageFrost> Frost Damage according to the season.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Astral Invaders
traits.description: Astral sea creatures have been drawn to this realm's sources of mana and guard them jealously.<bulletlist><bullet><mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink] are defended by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralMonstersLoreConcept]Astral Sea Monsters[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Birds of Paradise
traits.description: The realm is home to many birds, civilized and wild.<bulletlist><bullet>Avian <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.GREAT_BIRD_NEST_SPAWNER]Great Bird Nests[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Bird [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Celestial Grounds
traits.description: Celestials are common on this realm, replacing all other infestations and Ancient Wonders.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.CRUSADER_HOST]Crusader Host[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Constructed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink] such as Ziggurats are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Demonic Realm
traits.description: Infernal Fiends plague this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INFERNAL_FIEND]Infernal Fiend[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Dragon Territories
traits.description: Dragons claim this realm as their hunting grounds, their lairs dominating much of the land, warding off any competition.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRAGON]Dragon[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Fractured Infestations
traits.description: The realm has various fractures from which mana-starved creatures emerge.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FRACTURED_INFESTATION]Fractured Infestations[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>These [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink] spread [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Frostling Influence
traits.description: Frostlings have long since found this world, and none are unaffected by their freezing influence.<bulletlist><bullet>Independent Units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROSTLING_TRANSFORMATION_PROPERTY_GROUP]Frostling Transformation[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Independent Units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROST_BLADES_PROPERTY_GROUP]Frost Strikes[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Independent Units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROST_ARROWS_PROPERTY_GROUP]Frost Arrows[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Immortal Spirits
traits.description: This realm features many Ethereal spirits.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Land of Conflict
traits.description: Forces of calamity and prosperity occupy this land.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ACCURSED]Accursed Fiend[/hyperlink] and Prosperity [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Lingering Creators
traits.description: Giants and demigiants are prevalent on this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GIANT]Giant[/hyperlink] and ogre [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Magic Origins
traits.description: Astral influence on this realm makes creatures of a magic origin unusually common.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origins[/hyperlink] creatures are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue> on this realm.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Megafauna
traits.description: The beasts of this realm are especially large and ferocious.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EMPOWERED_BEASTS_PROPERTY_GROUP]Empowered Beasts[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Mistwalker Incursion
traits.description: The Mistwalkers have invaded this realm, setting up a permanent military presence.<bulletlist><bullet>Mistwalker Camp [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Peaceful Lands
traits.description: This realm features mostly benevolent spirits and creatures.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEY]Fey[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PLANT]Plant[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Rampant Flora
traits.description: Living flora sprawls all over this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PLANT]Plant[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Rampant Undeath
traits.description: The Undead plague this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Wildlands
traits.description: Wild animals are common on this realm, replacing all other infestations and Ancient Wonders.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Constructed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink] such as Ziggurats are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Archon Prophet
traits.description: Claiming to be the chosen of the Archon, a prophet has united the houses of this realm under their banner.The Archon Prophet Meshara starts with a large [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink].Meshara starts with all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink].Whoever defeats Meshara is Victorious.

traits.name: Artisan Kings
traits.description: This realm is home to two powerful cities, each an empire in itself, lead by Artisan Kings.The Artisan Kings Tugrum and Qualok start with massive [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne Cities[/hyperlink].Each Artisan King starts with a nearby [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassal[/hyperlink].

traits.name: Demon Prince
traits.description: This realm is dominated by a powerful Demonic Prince of Obbadoth and their minions.The Demonic Prince Karavar starts with a large [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink].The Demonic Prince starts with 2 additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].The Demonic Prince's minions gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMONKIN]Demonkin[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPERGROWTH_PROPERTY_GROUP]Supergrowth[/hyperlink].Whoever defeats Karavar is Victorious.

traits.name: Domain of the Frost Queen
traits.description: This realm is dominated by a powerful queen of frost and winter.The Frost Queen Artica starts with a large [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink].The Frost Queen starts with 2 additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].The Frost Queen's minions gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROSTLING_TRANSFORMATION_PROPERTY_GROUP]Frostling Transformation[/hyperlink].Whoever defeats Artica is Victorious.

traits.name: Druidic Alliance
traits.description: This Realm has attracted the interest of two powerful Druids, seeking to guide its growth and protect it from meddlers.The Druids Myrala and Kyrma start with powerful Nature Skills.Myrala and Kyrma start in an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliance[/hyperlink].

traits.name: Iron Emperor
traits.description: The Iron Emperor, Ydgaard, has chosen this realm to build a new empire.The Iron Emperor Ydgaard starts with powerful Materium Skills.Ydgaard starts with +1 additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink].

traits.name: Pretender Kings
traits.description: The kingdom that once dominated this realm has fallen, and 3 successors lay claim to the throne of this once prosperous kingdom.The Pretender Kings Darman, Jarlan and Skogan start with +2 additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].Each Pretender King starts at [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] with the other Pretender Kings.Whoever forms an alliance with or defeats each Pretender King is Victorious.

traits.name: Primal Dispute
traits.description: This Realm is the stage of a violent dispute between the Godir Serena and Nimue, whose primal followers fight a bloody conflict.The Primal Godir Nimue and Serena start with powerful Nature Skills.Nimue and Serena start at [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink].Whoever forms an alliance with or defeats each Primal Godir is Victorious.

traits.name: Sworn Rivalry
traits.description: This Realm is the stage of a violent dispute between three Oathsworn Godir, who disagree on matters of doctrine.The Oathsworn Godir Xorn, Aya, and Megaira are present and start at a higher level.Xorn, Aya, and Megaira start at [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink].

traits.name: The Ashen War
traits.description: The Elder Dragons that guide this realm have descended into a brutal conflict now known as the Ashen War, each side seeking to guide the realm's growth as they believe is best.The Dawnwardens Soncevar, Sumuskira, and Boszorkan start in an Alliance and at war with each of the Reshapers.The Reshapers Kralicavir, Vox'Sebas, and Allipavar start in an Alliance and at war with each of the Dawnwardens.Each of the Elder Dragons is extremely powerful and has a powerful unique ability owing to their Affinity; they extend lesser versions of these abilities to their chosen Heroes.Whoever forms an alliance with all Elder Dragons or forms an alliance with all members of either Alliance and defeats each member of the opposing alliance is Victorious.

traits.name: The Librarian
traits.description: An Astral ruler known only as "the Librarian" rules an empire on this realm.The Librarian Noctus starts with powerful Astral Skills.Noctus starts with +1 additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink].Noctus gains accelerated [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchConcept]Research[/hyperlink].Whoever defeats Noctus is Victorious.

traits.name: Arctic Blizzards
traits.description: Freezing blizzards rage over this realm's arctic regions.<bulletlist><bullet>Arctic [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by arctic blizzards.</bullet><bullet>All surface combat is affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS]Snow Storm[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in these provinces suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS_UNIT_PROPERTY]Arctic Blizzards[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Barren and Fractured
traits.description: This realm bears scars of a magical calamity.<bulletlist><bullet>Handcrafted regions containing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>common</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>Ruined [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink] such as the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WITHERED_TREE]Withered Tree[/hyperlink] are more <abilityblue>common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Crystalline Abundance
traits.description: Mana crystals grow more easily on this realm, making them unusually abundant.<bulletlist><bullet><mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>abundant</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Domain of Mayhem
traits.description: This realm has a maddening influence, seeping into the minds of those that fight in its lands.<bulletlist><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] is affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOMAIN_OF_MAYHEM]Domain of Mayhem[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Hostile Seas
traits.description: Sea Storms are a permanent feature of this world's seas, making them exceptionally dangerous.<bulletlist><bullet>Surface water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] are affected by Sea Storms.</bullet><bullet>Combat in these [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] is affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOSTILE_OCEANS_SEA_STORM_COMBAT_AUTO_SPELL]Sea Storm[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in these provinces suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOSTILE_OCEANS_UNIT_PROPERTY]Hostile Seas[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Ruined Nodes
traits.description: The realm's natural resources are partially depleted.<bulletlist><bullet>Around half of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] present at the start are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RuinedNodeConcept]Ruined[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Resource Nodes in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] at the start will not be Ruined.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Subdued Infestations
traits.description: The wildlife on this realm is more dormant than usual. <bulletlist><bullet>The realm starts with a reduced amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Sunless Highlands
traits.description: This realm consists of a mountainous and sunless heartland that gets colder towards the edges.<bulletlist><bullet>The following [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Abundant</abilityblue>:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SunlessConcept]Sunless[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>The following Province Features are <abilityblue>Scarce</abilityblue>:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LavaConcept]Lava[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>The following Province Feature is <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Volcanic Eruptions
traits.description: Volcanic activity rages beneath this realm's desolate regions.<bulletlist><bullet>All surface combat in desolate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] is affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_VOLCANIC_ERUPTION]Volcanic Eruptions[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Units in desolate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLCANIC_HEAT_UNIT_PROPERTY]Volcanic Heat[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Warping Wilds
traits.description: This realm is in an unnatural state of flux, warping and transforming constantly.<bulletlist><bullet>Each strategic <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], all unowned surface provinces have a small chance of transforming their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink] to new ones.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Wondrous Past
traits.description: Due to the rich past of this realm, there are many Ancient Wonders present.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common<abilityblue></abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: City States
traits.description: This realm features unusually powerful free cities, which have grown into city states of their own right with a pride to match.<bulletlist><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] start with +5 <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet><allegiance></allegiance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfluenceConcept]Whispering Stone Strength[/hyperlink] is reduced by -50%.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Crystal Dwelling
traits.description: There is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingConcept]Crystal Dwelling[/hyperlink] present on this map, engaged in its eternal search for knowledge.

traits.name: Distrusting Locals
traits.description: The locals do not trust easily, making diplomacy difficult.<bulletlist><bullet><allegiance></allegiance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfluenceConcept]Whispering Stone Strength[/hyperlink] is reduced by -3.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Hostile Houses
traits.description: The houses of this realm are used to treachery and war, taking no chances with outsiders.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] suffer -10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] and -400 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept]Relations[/hyperlink] with each <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] they meet.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Low Population
traits.description: This realm features less civilization than others.<bulletlist><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Might Makes Right
traits.description: The houses of this realm respect strength above all. They will grow more loyal to proven conquerors.<bulletlist><bullet>Conquering <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] grants +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] with all other <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink] gain +2 Allegiance Levels when first vassalized through conquest.</bullet><bullet><allegiance></allegiance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfluenceConcept]Whispering Stone Strength[/hyperlink] is reduced by -50%.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: No Free Cities
traits.description: This realm is young and unclaimed.<bulletlist><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Absent</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Ruined Realm
traits.description: This realm has seen brutal conflict in the past.<bulletlist><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Rare</abilityblue>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityRuinConcept]City Ruins[/hyperlink] are <abilityblue>Common</abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Echoes of The Fracturing
traits.description:
Long ago, this realm was home to some of the experiments of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnmakersLoreConcept]Unmakers[/hyperlink].
There are Fated Regions present on the map which offer quest chains exploring the present and past of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TheFracturingLoreConcept]the Fracturing[/hyperlink].Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArtifactConcept]Artifacts[/hyperlink] when completing Fated Regions, which grant control over the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept]Cataclysm[/hyperlink] that ravages this realm. Obtaining three of them will lead to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CataclysmVictoryConcept]Cataclysm Victory[/hyperlink].Fated Regions are affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WARDED_BY_FATE]Ward of Fates[/hyperlink].

traits.name: Legends of Myrrida
traits.description:
This realm was once part of the fabled Giant kingdom called [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink].
There are Fated Regions present on the map which offer quest chains exploring the present and past of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink].Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArtifactConcept]Artifacts[/hyperlink] when completing Fated Regions, which grant unique bonuses and can be collected to start impactful follow-up Happenings.Fated Regions are affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WARDED_BY_FATE]Ward of Fates[/hyperlink].Only some of the Fated Regions available will be present, leaving more to be explored on another realm.

traits.name: Blessed Regions
traits.description: The Archons of old have left their blessings in several locations on this realm's surface.<bulletlist><bullet>Several hand-crafted regions with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept]Blessed[/hyperlink] can appear on the surface.</bullet><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FOUNTAIN_OF_CREATION_LANDMARK]Fountain of Creation[/hyperlink] can appear on the surface.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Blocked Underground
traits.description: This realm features a dense earth, resulting in an absence of underground caverns and passages.<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept]Underground[/hyperlink] is <abilityblue>Absent<abilityblue></abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Explorative Underground
traits.description: The Underground in this realm is a labyrinth of tunnels and small caverns, filled with treasure, but not as suitable for settling.<bulletlist><bullet>The Underground's caverns are much smaller, but are more numerous.</bullet><bullet>Additional pickups appear in the Underground.</bullet><bullet>Additional Ancient Wonders appear in the Underground.</bullet><bullet>More Underground provinces are covered in diggable earth.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Massive Underground
traits.description: This realm has unusually large caverns.<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept]Underground[/hyperlink] is <abilityblue>bigger<abilityblue></abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Scarce Waters
traits.description: Most of the valuable resources on the ocean and lakes in this realm have sunken far below and become unobtainable.<bulletlist><bullet>Reduced amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink] are present on the water on the Surface and in the Underground</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Shrouded Isles
traits.description:
Ancient gates are scattered throughout the realm. They lead to floating isles in a mysterious dimension where powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] hid away their most prized secrets.
A new Shrouded map layer is added to the realm.This layer contains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShroudedIsleConcept]Shrouded Isles[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BreachedIsleConcept]Breached Isles[/hyperlink].Various portals can be found on the Surface and Underground which lead to these Isles.

traits.name: Small Underground
traits.description: This realm has unusually small caverns.<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept]Underground[/hyperlink] is <abilityblue>smaller<abilityblue></abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Subdued Umbral Abyss
traits.description: A lesser version of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>No Umbral <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwellings[/hyperlink] present.</bullet><bullet>Reduced amount of Umbral islands with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Reduced amount of Umbral islands and Umbral Gates overall.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Sunless Regions
traits.description: There are various places on this realm's surface the sun never seems to touch.<bulletlist><bullet>Several hand-crafted regions with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SunlessConcept]Sunless[/hyperlink] can appear on the Surface.</bullet><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.THORN_HEART_LANDMARK]Thorn Heart[/hyperlink] can appear on the Surface.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BLOOD_GLASS]Blood Glass[/hyperlink] can appear on the Surface.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Umbral Abyss
traits.description: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink] creeps over this realm, opening gates to an eldritch dimension and its invading horrors:<bulletlist><bullet>An additional map layer called the Umbral Abyss is added, which can be reached through Umbral Gates.</bullet><bullet>Enter the Umbral Abyss for forbidden treasures—at a great risk!</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink] and <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwellings[/hyperlink] from the Umbral Abyss will creep into the Surface and Underground, spreading [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in Gloom Terrain will suffer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS]Umbral Malady[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Unearthed
traits.description: No excavation needs to be done in this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept]Underground[/hyperlink] in this realm will have no Diggable Earth.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Uninhabitable Underground
traits.description: This realm has unusually small, unwelcoming caverns.<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept]Underground[/hyperlink] is <abilityblue>smaller</abilityblue>. </bullet><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] starts aboveground, regardless of adaptation traits.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Untouched
traits.description: This realm has had no meddling from outside creators.<bulletlist><bullet>No [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HandcraftedRegionConcept]Handcrafted Regions[/hyperlink] will be present in this realm's surface and underground.</bullet><bullet>Does not affect Handcrafted Regions from other Realm Traits or Story Realms.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Bannerlords
traits.description: This world's Free Cities make powerful allies.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink] occur +25% more often.</bullet><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] gain +5 <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RecruitmentPointsConcept]Recruitment Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Chaotic Influence
traits.description: Chaotic energies make emotions run high.<bulletlist><bullet>Each strategic <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] gain a stacking negative [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]Empire Relation[/hyperlink] modifier with each other.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Deathcasting
traits.description: The mortals of this realm are infused with its magic, releasing it on their deaths.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] grant their owner +10 <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink] on death.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Disdain for Evil
traits.description: The people on this realm despise evil and will fight to prevent it from taking root.<bulletlist><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] gain <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] with Evil [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Megacities
traits.description: This world allows for the construction of immense megacities, yet traditional expansion is impossible.<bulletlist><bullet>Cannot absorb, migrate, or settle new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] can perform [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept]Province Annexation[/hyperlink] +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] further away.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] gain +3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Route[/hyperlink] capacity.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Motivated Truce
traits.description: Waging war is discouraged on this realm.<bulletlist><bullet><casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] are less impactful.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: No Respite
traits.description: This realm actively interferes with natural healing.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.NO_RESPITE_PROPERTY]No Respite[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Regenerating Infestations
traits.description: Beasts and monsters never cease nesting in this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink] emerge in unoccupied [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] every 10 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Surface Start
traits.description: This realm's upstarts all originate from the surface. <bulletlist><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink], even those with Underground Adaptation, start with their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink] on the Surface.</bullet><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] and <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwellings[/hyperlink] are unaffected.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Timelocked Tomes
traits.description: This realm has a strange connection to the tides of the Astral Sea, high tides of inspiration follow ebbs where none can be found. Tomes of magic are discovered only when the tides of the Astral sea will it.<bulletlist><bullet>Tomes are not discovered as Research Skills are unlocked.</bullet><bullet>Tomes are unlocked simultaneously for all Rulers at set intervals based on the Realm's research speed setting.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Unbound Tomes
traits.description: The affinities blur and blend on this realm, allowing access to tomes otherwise restricted.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tomes[/hyperlink] have no [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] requirements.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Underground Start
traits.description: Civilization only thrives underground on this realm, forcing the throne cities of each empire underground.<bulletlist><bullet>Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] starts [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept]Underground[/hyperlink], regardless of any adaptation traits.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Unlimited Power
traits.description: This realm is awash with Astral power, and spells flow freely without limit, though they require more mana to channel.<bulletlist><bullet>Can now cast multiple [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] cost 200% more <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] to cast.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Unstable Astral Flow
traits.description: The Astral Flow through this realm is tumultuous.<bulletlist><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] have a base 20% chance to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfiring[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Curse of Undeath
traits.description: The inhabitants of this realm are cursed with a restless death.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] and <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CURSE_OF_UNDEATH]Curse of Undeath[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Dissonant Enchantments
traits.description: This realm resists enchantment magic, requiring significantly more mana and effort to be cast and maintained than usual.<bulletlist><bullet><caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantments[/hyperlink] cost +100% more to cast.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpgradeUpkeepConcept]Unit Enchantment Upkeep[/hyperlink] is increased by +100%.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Expendable Legions
traits.description:
Life is cheap in this realm, and with that comes a near limitless supply of recruits. However, elites and powerful monsters are in turn much harder to come by.
Tier 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] have their recruitment costs in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] decreased by 50% in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].Tier 1 Units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPENDABLE]Expendable[/hyperlink].Tier 3 and higher Units have their recruitment costs in Cities increased by 50%.

traits.name: Gigantism
traits.description: The beings of this realm are lower in number but especially large.<bulletlist><bullet>Racial [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPERGROWTH_PROPERTY_GROUP]Supergrowth[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Heavy Fog
traits.description: In this realm, endless banks of fog obscure vision.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept]Vision Range[/hyperlink] of all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] is reduced by -1.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: High Maintenance
traits.description: Materials on this realm are weak, easily worked with, but hard to maintain.<bulletlist><bullet>Base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] is increased by 100%.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] recruit costs are reduced by -50%.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Immortals
traits.description: This realm's magic wards off death, preventing true death for many.<bulletlist><bullet>All non-Ruler [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMORTAL]Immortal[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routed[/hyperlink] units are never lost.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: Ward of the Archons
traits.description: A powerful spell woven by the Archons wards off death, preventing true death for Celestials.<bulletlist><bullet>All non-Ruler [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMORTAL_ARCHON_WARD]Immortal Ward[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routed[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] units are never lost.</bullet></bulletlist>

traits.name: World Seals
traits.description: Seals are present on this realm. Capturing them will lead to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept]Seals Victory[/hyperlink].

traits.name: World Seals (Active)
traits.description:
Seals are present on this realm. Capturing them will lead to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept]Seals Victory[/hyperlink].
- Fewer Seal Points are required to achieve victory.

traits.name: World Seals (Ample)
traits.description:
Seals are present on this realm. Capturing them will lead to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept]Seals Victory[/hyperlink].
- More Seals are present on this realm.

traits.name: World Seals (Dormant)
traits.description:
Seals are present on this realm. Capturing them will lead to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept]Seals Victory[/hyperlink].
- More Seal Points are required to achieve victory.

traits.name: World Seals (Scarce)
traits.description:
Seals are present on this realm. Capturing them will lead to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept]Seals Victory[/hyperlink].
- Fewer Seals are present on this realm.
